title: atadenoise: decision-log template and arm-failure diagnostic guide
purpose: Provides a structured log template and diagnostic guide for the four-arm atadenoise experiment (control, short-window s=5, long-window s=17, scout_0b). Separates technical observations from taste judgments, maps failure symptoms to probable causes, and gives a decision procedure that can be followed by anyone running the experiment — not just the original author.
